text:
Theo (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. customers and sales want a compact, non-technical timeline for: Console batching controls, API billing tiers, and Optimize suggestions. can we publish a short timeline + owners today?

Rina (Eng): high-level engineering view: Console batching - internal canary last week of June; partner beta mid-July; public rollout late July pending ops cert. API billing tiers - beta late July, GA mid-August. Optimize suggestions (read-only) - end of June; write-mode later in the quarter.

Jules (DevEx): request from GTM: we need a migration playbook + a one-paragraph blurb AEs can use on calls. will create AE script + sample customer message.

Karim (Sales): sales asks: (1) clear rollback steps, (2) a migration checklist for customers on heavy-throughput routes, (3) suggested notice window for Dedicated accounts.

Anya (Legal): legal note: for billing tiers we need proposed terms by July 1 to turn around redlines by July 10. confirm whether tier changes are opt-in or forced.

Rina (Eng): opt-in for existing keys by default. we'll add an admin-only opt-out toggle and a per-route override. sample admin API we'll publish: 

```
PUT /admin/v1/tenant/features
{ "smart_batching": false }
```

(only admin tokens).

Theo (Product): suggested single-line public sentence for portal: "Late-June internal canary; early-July partner beta; late-July public rollout (subject to certification and SLA signoff)." is that acceptable to comms?

Jules (DevEx): that's fine. DevEx will also publish a short migration checklist with exact opt-out steps and the AE script. target July 3 draft.

Karim (Sales): add a sample rollback blurb: "If you see increased latency after batching, toggle off smart_batching and contact your AE for priority support." simple enough for calls.

Rina (Eng): engineering deliverables: tenant opt-out endpoint, batching telemetry (batching_ratio, p50/p95 token latency), and read-only flag for Optimize suggestions. PRs for canary by June 21.

Anya (Legal): confirming: if product sends the tiering terms by July 1, legal will provide redlines by July 10. also need explicit data-use text for Optimize suggestions.

infra-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: runtime v1.9.3 -> us-west cluster on 2024-06-26T03:00:00Z (4 nodes).

Theo (Product): action items: (A) publish one-pager timeline + footnotes (owner: Theo) by EOD, (B) migration playbook + AE script (owner: Jules) draft by July 3, (C) legal terms to Anya by July 1 (owner: Theo), (D) eng canary PRs (owner: Rina) by June 21.

Jules (DevEx): I'll start the playbook and drop a PR for the AE script. tagging owners in the doc.

Theo (Product): thanks all. i'll post the one-pager to #all-hands and #customer-comm and pin it. please flag any blockers here. :spiral_calendar_pad:
